result.title: From Single-Shot QA to Continuous Perception: Revisiting the Energy Composition and Optimization Boundary of Edge VLMs
result.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining 2026 Teen Research Track
result.summary: Visual-prefill energy conclusions for edge vision-language models (VLMs) are commonly drawn under single-shot workloads; we revisit them under continuous perception. Profiling nine VLMs across three architecture families on Jetson AGX Thor and Orin (4,508 records, calibrated with a pure-text task), we find two mutually independent energy laws: the per-output-token decode cost grows monotonically with model scale, whereas the visual-prefill (image-encoding) cost is dominated by visual-encoder architectural efficiency, not scale. Under continuous perception ($N{=}10$) with sparse output, visual-prefill energy reaches 92--97\% of total. We derive optimization strategies---visual frame reuse, adaptive output truncation, task-aware routing, and encoder throughput optimization---for edge VLM deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 在两款 Jetson 平台上剖析三个架构家族的 9 个边缘 VLM，共 4,508 条记录，得到两条相互独立的能耗规律：每输出 token 的解码成本随模型规模单调增长，而视觉 prefill 成本由视觉编码器的架构效率而非规模主导；连续感知且输出稀疏时视觉 prefill 占总能耗 92–97%，并据此提出帧复用、自适应输出截断、任务感知路由与编码器吞吐优化等策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其视觉 prefill 与解码的能耗分解可为 LOOK/STOP 的成本核算和自适应输出截断提供量化参照，但论文不触及内部 latent 状态或用例是否被使用，能否迁移到 LVR 的收益—成本权衡仍待核查。
